season.source: https://www.paddlebrave.com/ ('Our grounds are open May to November') + /camping-cabins ('Our campground is 3 seasons, weather dependent'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Camping is reserved by phone (989-275-5273); the online 'Book Now' engine (Peek) sells only river trips. The first night's fee is the deposit, due 30 days before arrival; specific sites not guaranteed. The two-night weekend minimum runs May 15 - September 15 only. Cancel 30+ days ahead for a refund less a processing fee, 50% up to 2 weeks out, none within 14 days. Up to 2 cars or a trailer and 1 car per site.

booking.source: https://www.paddlebrave.com/camping-cabins ('There is a two-night minimum weekends May 15 thru September 15', 'Reservation Policy: First night's camping fee required for camp reservations', 'Call Now!') + the Peek page (Kayak & Canoe Rentals, Tubing only), read 2026-10-22

note: Private campground and canoe/kayak livery on the South Branch AuSable River, Roscommon: a small, old-fashioned campground with camping cabins and rental campers; group sites hold up to 3 travel trailers. --Claude
summary: Operator's camping page confirms 2026 electric sites $32 (up to 4), 30 A electric only (no water/sewer at sites), drinking-water fill, dump, showers, Wi-Fi; added season May-November, phone booking with deposit, and the two-night weekend minimum (May 15 - Sep 15). Site count (43) and 40-ft limit are not stated on the operator's pages; left. Note corrected: 'walk-ins or online reservations' applies to river trips, not camping.
